body_markdown: Can the incidence roadmap expose an $(\epsilon,a)$-core as in AE-03 and ensure that any selected $T'\subseteq T$ retains all core edges incident to each selected line? AE-18--AE-20 need the inherited lower bound $\deg_G(L)\ge k$; a universal smaller reaching family is ruled out by AE-14, so a decode alternative must accompany sparsification.
subject: Whole-line core handoff
